report/charts.js (502 líneas)
// Gráficas de la página, dibujadas en SVG a partir de los datos de results/fig_*.json (report/build.py los incrusta).
// Colores por variables CSS (--c1, --c2, --c3, --ink, --muted, --rule, --sheet), así que siguen el modo claro u oscuro.
(() => {
  const DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('figdata').textContent);
  const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  const PI = Math.PI;

  const svgEl = (tag, attrs = {}, parent) => {
    const e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag);
    for (const k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]);
    if (parent) parent.appendChild(e);
    return e;
  };
  const htmlEl = (tag, cls, parent) => {
    const e = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    if (parent) parent.appendChild(e);
    return e;
  };

  // "m_{eff}^{2}" -> texto con subíndices y superíndices, en SVG o en HTML
  const PARTS = /([_^])\{([^}]*)\}/g;
  function richSvg(t, s) {
    let i = 0, m;
    PARTS.lastIndex = 0;
    while ((m = PARTS.exec(s))) {
      if (m.index > i) t.appendChild(document.createTextNode(s.slice(i, m.index)));
      const ts = svgEl('tspan', { 'baseline-shift': m[1] === '_' ? 'sub' : 'super', 'font-size': '75%' }, t);
      ts.textContent = m[2];
      i = PARTS.lastIndex;
    }
    if (i < s.length) t.appendChild(document.createTextNode(s.slice(i)));
    return t;
  }
  function richHtml(e, s) {
    let i = 0, m;
    PARTS.lastIndex = 0;
    while ((m = PARTS.exec(s))) {
      if (m.index > i) e.appendChild(document.createTextNode(s.slice(i, m.index)));
      htmlEl(m[1] === '_' ? 'sub' : 'sup', '', e).textContent = m[2];
      i = PARTS.lastIndex;
    }
    if (i < s.length) e.appendChild(document.createTextNode(s.slice(i)));
    return e;
  }

  const minus = s => s.replace(/-/g, '−');
  const fmt = (v, d = 3) => minus(Number(v).toFixed(d));
  const sci = v => {
    const e = Math.floor(Math.log10(v));
    const sup = { '-': '⁻', 0: '⁰', 1: '¹', 2: '²', 3: '³', 4: '⁴', 5: '⁵', 6: '⁶', 7: '⁷', 8: '⁸', 9: '⁹' };
    return e === 0 ? '1' : '10' + String(e).split('').map(c => sup[c]).join('');
  };

  function niceTicks(a, b, n) {
    const step0 = (b - a) / n, p = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(step0)), f = step0 / p;
    const step = (f < 1.5 ? 1 : f < 3 ? 2 : f < 7 ? 5 : 10) * p;
    const out = [];
    for (let v = Math.ceil(a / step) * step; v <= b + step * 1e-9; v += step) out.push(+v.toFixed(10));
    return out.map(v => [v, minus(String(+v.toPrecision(6)))]);
  }

  function scale(ax, r0, r1) {
    if (ax.log) {
      const l0 = Math.log10(ax.min), l1 = Math.log10(ax.max);
      const f = v => r0 + (Math.log10(Math.max(v, ax.min * 1e-3)) - l0) / (l1 - l0) * (r1 - r0);
      f.inv = p => 10 ** (l0 + (p - r0) / (r1 - r0) * (l1 - l0));
      return f;
    }
    const f = v => r0 + (v - ax.min) / (ax.max - ax.min) * (r1 - r0);
    f.inv = p => ax.min + (p - r0) / (r1 - r0) * (ax.max - ax.min);
    return f;
  }

  const cssVar = name => getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name).trim();
  function rgb(hex) {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');
    c.fillStyle = hex;
    const h = c.fillStyle;   // normaliza a #rrggbb
    return [1, 3, 5].map(i => parseInt(h.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
  }

  // clave de leyenda: línea, línea discontinua, área, punto o anillo
  function key(kind, color, parent) {
    const s = svgEl('svg', { viewBox: '0 0 18 10', width: 18, height: 10, 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, parent);
    const st = `stroke:var(${color});fill:var(${color})`;
    if (kind === 'area') svgEl('rect', { x: 1, y: 1, width: 16, height: 8, rx: 2, style: `fill:var(${color});opacity:.25` }, s);
    else if (kind === 'dot') svgEl('circle', { cx: 9, cy: 5, r: 4, style: st }, s);
    else if (kind === 'ring') svgEl('circle', { cx: 9, cy: 5, r: 3.5, style: `stroke:var(${color});fill:var(--sheet);stroke-width:2` }, s);
    else if (kind === 'heat') svgEl('rect', { x: 1, y: 1, width: 16, height: 8, rx: 2, style: `fill:url(#heatkey)` }, s);
    else svgEl('line', { x1: 1, y1: 5, x2: 17, y2: 5, style: `stroke:var(${color});stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round` + (kind === 'dash' ? ';stroke-dasharray:4 3' : '') }, s);
    return s;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ motor
  function render(box, spec) {
    box.textContent = '';
    const head = htmlEl('div', 'chead', box);
    richHtml(htmlEl('h4', '', head), spec.title);
    if (spec.sub) richHtml(htmlEl('p', 'sub', head), spec.sub);
    if (spec.legend) {
      const lg = htmlEl('div', 'legend', box);
      for (const [kind, color, name] of spec.legend) {
        const it = htmlEl('span', '', lg);
        if (kind === 'heat') {
          const bar = htmlEl('i', 'heatbar', it);
          bar.style.background = `linear-gradient(90deg, var(--c1), var(--sheet))`;
        } else key(kind, color, it);
        richHtml(htmlEl('span', '', it), name);
      }
    }

    const W = Math.max(260, Math.round(box.clientWidth - 2)), H = spec.h || 290;
    const m = { l: spec.ml || 52, r: 14, t: 12, b: spec.mb || 42 };
    const svg = svgEl('svg', { class: 'plot', viewBox: `0 0 ${W} ${H}`, role: 'img', 'aria-label': spec.aria }, box);
    const X = scale(spec.x, m.l, W - m.r), Y = scale(spec.y, H - m.b, m.t);
    const id = 'c' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
    const defs = svgEl('defs', {}, svg);
    const cp = svgEl('clipPath', { id: id + 'clip' }, defs);
    svgEl('rect', { x: m.l, y: m.t, width: W - m.l - m.r, height: H - m.t - m.b }, cp);

    // rejilla y ejes
    const g = svgEl('g', { class: 'grid' }, svg);
    const xt = spec.x.ticks || niceTicks(spec.x.min, spec.x.max, Math.max(3, Math.floor((W - m.l) / 80)));
    const yt = spec.y.ticks || niceTicks(spec.y.min, spec.y.max, 5);
    for (const [v, lab] of yt) {
      const y = Y(v);
      svgEl('line', { x1: m.l, x2: W - m.r, y1: y, y2: y }, g);
      svgEl('text', { x: m.l - 7, y: y + 3.5, 'text-anchor': 'end', class: 'tick' }, svg).textContent = lab;
    }
    for (const [v, lab] of xt) {
      const x = X(v);
      if (!spec.x.nogrid) svgEl('line', { x1: x, x2: x, y1: m.t, y2: H - m.b }, g);
      richSvg(svgEl('text', { x, y: H - m.b + 15, 'text-anchor': 'middle', class: 'tick' }, svg), lab);
    }
    svgEl('line', { x1: m.l, x2: W - m.r, y1: H - m.b, y2: H - m.b, class: 'axis' }, svg);
    richSvg(svgEl('text', { x: (m.l + W - m.r) / 2, y: H - 6, 'text-anchor': 'middle', class: 'alabel' }, svg), spec.x.label);
    richSvg(svgEl('text', { x: 12, y: (m.t + H - m.b) / 2, 'text-anchor': 'middle', class: 'alabel',
      transform: `rotate(-90 12 ${(m.t + H - m.b) / 2})` }, svg), spec.y.label);

    const plot = svgEl('g', { 'clip-path': `url(#${id}clip)` }, svg);
    const over = svgEl('g', {}, svg);
    const pts = [], cross = [];
    const path = d => d.map(([x, y], i) => (i ? 'L' : 'M') + X(x).toFixed(1) + ' ' + Y(y).toFixed(1)).join('');

    for (const L of spec.layers) {
      const col = `var(${L.color || '--ink'})`;
      if (L.type === 'heat') {
        const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
        cv.width = L.nx; cv.height = L.ny;
        const ctx = cv.getContext('2d'), img = ctx.createImageData(L.nx, L.ny);
        const a = rgb(cssVar('--c1')), b = rgb(cssVar('--sheet'));
        for (let j = 0; j < L.ny; j++) for (let i = 0; i < L.nx; i++) {
          const t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (L.f[j * L.nx + i] / 10 - L.vmin) / (L.vmax - L.vmin))) ** 1.7;
          const o = ((L.ny - 1 - j) * L.nx + i) * 4;
          for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) img.data[o + c] = a[c] + (b[c] - a[c]) * t;
          img.data[o + 3] = 255;
        }
        ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
        svgEl('image', { href: cv.toDataURL(), x: X(L.x[0]), y: Y(L.y[1]), width: X(L.x[1]) - X(L.x[0]),
          height: Y(L.y[0]) - Y(L.y[1]), preserveAspectRatio: 'none', style: 'image-rendering:auto' }, plot);
        spec.heat = L;
      } else if (L.type === 'area') {
        const up = L.data.map(p => [p[0], p[2]]), lo = L.data.map(p => [p[0], p[1]]).reverse();
        svgEl('path', { d: path(up) + path(lo).replace('M', 'L') + 'Z', style: `fill:${col};opacity:${L.opacity || 0.14}` }, plot);
      } else if (L.type === 'line') {
        svgEl('path', { d: path(L.data), class: 'line', style: `stroke:${col};stroke-width:${L.width || 2}` + (L.dash ? `;stroke-dasharray:${L.dash}` : '') }, plot);
        if (L.name) cross.push(L);
      } else if (L.type === 'hline' || L.type === 'vline') {
        const h = L.type === 'hline';
        const a = h ? { x1: m.l, x2: W - m.r, y1: Y(L.at), y2: Y(L.at) } : { x1: X(L.at), x2: X(L.at), y1: m.t, y2: H - m.b };
        svgEl('line', { ...a, style: `stroke:${col};stroke-width:${L.width || 1.2}` + (L.dash ? `;stroke-dasharray:${L.dash}` : '') }, plot);
        if (L.label) {
          const t = h ? { x: L.lx != null ? X(L.lx) : W - m.r - 4, y: Y(L.at) - 5, 'text-anchor': L.lx != null ? 'start' : 'end' }
                      : { x: X(L.at) + (L.left ? -5 : 5), y: L.ly != null ? Y(L.ly) : m.t + 11, 'text-anchor': L.left ? 'end' : 'start' };
          richSvg(svgEl('text', { ...t, class: 'dlabel' }, over), L.label);
        }
      } else if (L.type === 'points') {
        for (const p of L.data) {
          const cx = X(p[0]), cy = Y(p[1]);
          if (L.err) svgEl('line', { x1: cx, x2: cx, y1: Y(p[1] - p[2]), y2: Y(p[1] + p[2]), style: `stroke:${col};stroke-width:1.5;opacity:.55` }, plot);
          svgEl('circle', { cx, cy, r: L.r || 4, class: L.hollow ? 'ring' : 'dot', style: L.hollow ? `stroke:${col}` : `fill:${col}` }, over);
          if (L.tip) pts.push({ cx, cy, color: L.color, tip: L.tip(p) });
        }
      } else if (L.type === 'text') {
        richSvg(svgEl('text', { x: X(L.x) + (L.dx || 0), y: Y(L.y) + (L.dy || 0), 'text-anchor': L.anchor || 'start', class: 'dlabel' }, over), L.label);
      }
    }

    // capa de interacción: punto más cercano (radio 18 px), si no, cruz vertical o valor del mapa
    const tip = htmlEl('div', 'tip', box);
    tip.hidden = true;
    const hair = svgEl('line', { y1: m.t, y2: H - m.b, class: 'hair', visibility: 'hidden' }, svg);
    const hit = svgEl('rect', { x: m.l, y: m.t, width: W - m.l - m.r, height: H - m.t - m.b, fill: 'transparent' }, svg);
    const ring = svgEl('circle', { r: 7, class: 'hover', visibility: 'hidden' }, svg);

    function show(rows, px, py) {
      tip.textContent = '';
      for (const [color, value, name] of rows) {
        const row = htmlEl('div', 'row', tip);
        if (color) htmlEl('i', 'k', row).style.background = `var(${color})`;
        richHtml(htmlEl('b', '', row), value);
        if (name) richHtml(htmlEl('span', 'nm', row), name);
      }
      tip.hidden = false;
      const bw = box.clientWidth, tw = tip.offsetWidth, th = tip.offsetHeight;
      const svgTop = svg.getBoundingClientRect().top - box.getBoundingClientRect().top;
      const k = svg.getBoundingClientRect().width / W;
      let left = px * k + 14, top = svgTop + py * k - th - 10;
      if (left + tw > bw - 4) left = px * k - tw - 14;
      if (top < 4) top = svgTop + py * k + 14;
      tip.style.left = Math.max(4, left) + 'px';
      tip.style.top = top + 'px';
    }
    function hide() { tip.hidden = true; hair.setAttribute('visibility', 'hidden'); ring.setAttribute('visibility', 'hidden'); }

    function move(ev) {
      const r = svg.getBoundingClientRect(), k = W / r.width;
      const px = (ev.clientX - r.left) * k, py = (ev.clientY - r.top) * k;
      let best = null, bd = 18 * k;
      for (const p of pts) { const d = Math.hypot(p.cx - px, p.cy - py); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = p; } }
      if (best) {
        hair.setAttribute('visibility', 'hidden');
        Object.entries({ cx: best.cx, cy: best.cy, visibility: 'visible' }).forEach(([a, v]) => ring.setAttribute(a, v));
        ring.style.stroke = `var(${best.color || '--ink'})`;
        return show(best.tip, best.cx, best.cy);
      }
      ring.setAttribute('visibility', 'hidden');
      const xv = X.inv(px);
      if (cross.length) {
        const rows = [];
        let snap = null;
        for (const L of cross) {
          let bi = 0;
          for (let i = 1; i < L.data.length; i++) if (Math.abs(L.data[i][0] - xv) < Math.abs(L.data[bi][0] - xv)) bi = i;
          snap = snap ?? L.data[bi][0];
          rows.push([L.color, L.fmt ? L.fmt(L.data[bi][1]) : fmt(L.data[bi][1]), L.name]);
        }
        hair.setAttribute('x1', X(snap)); hair.setAttribute('x2', X(snap)); hair.setAttribute('visibility', 'visible');
        return show([[null, spec.x.fmt ? spec.x.fmt(snap) : fmt(snap), spec.x.name || '']].concat(rows), X(snap), py);
      }
      if (spec.heat) {
        const L = spec.heat, yv = Y.inv(py);
        const i = Math.round((xv - L.x[0]) / (L.x[1] - L.x[0]) * (L.nx - 1)), j = Math.round((yv - L.y[0]) / (L.y[1] - L.y[0]) * (L.ny - 1));
        if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= L.nx || j >= L.ny) return hide();
        return show([[null, `ω̄ = ${fmt(xv, 2)} ${yv < 0 ? '−' : '+'} ${Math.abs(yv).toFixed(2)}i`, ''],
          [null, fmt(L.f[j * L.nx + i] / 10, 1), 'log_{10}|f|']], px, py);
      }
      hide();
    }
    hit.addEventListener('pointermove', move);
    hit.addEventListener('pointerdown', move);
    hit.addEventListener('pointerleave', hide);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ las figuras
  const zip = (a, b) => a.map((v, i) => [v, b[i]]);
  const SPECS = {};

  // masa efectiva frente a theta
  {
    const d = DATA.meff, v10 = d.a10[0], vpi = d.a10[d.a10.length - 1];
    SPECS.meff = {
      title: 'Masa efectiva del axión con las funciones completas', sub: 'β = 0.88; el modelo simplificado usa el valor en θ = 0',
      aria: `m_eff² / m_a² frente a θ. Para α = 10 vale ${fmt(v10, 0)} en θ = 0 y +${vpi.toFixed(0)} en θ = π.`,
      legend: [['line', '--c1', 'α = n_{b}/n_{c} = 10 (interior)'], ['line', '--c2', 'α = 0.5 (fuera de la capa)']],
      x: { min: -0.12, max: PI + 0.12, ticks: [[0, '0'], [PI / 2, 'π/2'], [PI, 'π']], label: 'θ = a/f_{a}  (fondo en el que se linealiza)', fmt: v => 'θ = ' + (v / PI).toFixed(2) + 'π' },
      y: { min: -12, max: 30, label: 'm_{eff}^{2} / m_{a}^{2}' },
      layers: [
        { type: 'hline', at: 0, color: '--muted', width: 1 },
        { type: 'line', data: zip(d.th, d.a05), color: '--c2', name: 'α = 0.5', fmt: v => fmt(v, 2) },
        { type: 'line', data: zip(d.th, d.a10), color: '--c1', name: 'α = 10', fmt: v => fmt(v, 2) },
        { type: 'points', color: '--c1', data: [[0, v10], [PI, vpi]],
          tip: p => [['--c1', fmt(p[1], 1), p[0] ? 'en θ = π: (α − 1)/√(1 − β)' : 'en θ = 0: 1 − α, el del paper']] },
        { type: 'text', x: 0, y: v10, dx: 10, dy: -9, label: `θ = 0: 1 − α = ${fmt(v10, 0)} (el del paper)` },
        { type: 'text', x: PI, y: vpi, dx: -10, dy: -10, anchor: 'end', label: `θ = π: +${vpi.toFixed(0)}` },
      ],
    };
  }

  // modelo simplificado: log|f| en el plano complejo
  DATA.toy.forEach((d, k) => {
    SPECS['toy' + k] = {
      title: k ? 'Linealizando en θ = π' : 'Modelo del paper, Ec. (4.13)',
      sub: k ? 'm_{eff}^{2} = (α − 1)/√(1 − β), ∂_{a}m* = 0' : 'λ^{2} = 10^{−3}, α = 10, c_{s}^{2} = 0.3, x̄_{0} = 0.6',
      aria: k ? 'Mapa de log|f| linealizando en θ = π: los modos fluidos quedan sobre el eje real y los axiónicos se desplazan.'
              : 'Mapa de log|f| del modelo del paper: diez modos fluidos junto al eje real y cinco axiónicos cada vez más amortiguados.',
      legend: [['heat', '--c1', 'log_{10}|f| (más intenso: más cerca de un cero)'], ['ring', '--c2', 'raíces (Muller)']],
      h: 270, x: { min: d.x[0], max: d.x[1], label: 'Re ω̄' }, y: { min: d.y[0], max: d.y[1], label: 'Im ω̄' },
      layers: [
        { type: 'heat', ...d, vmin: -1.5, vmax: 6 },
        { type: 'points', color: '--c2', hollow: true, r: 4, data: d.roots,
          tip: p => [['--c2', `${fmt(p[0], 2)} ${p[1] < -5e-5 ? '−' : '+'} ${Math.abs(p[1]).toFixed(2)}i`,
            Math.abs(p[1]) < 0.5 && (k === 0 || Math.abs(p[1]) < 1e-6) ? 'modo fluido' : 'modo axiónico']] },
      ],
    };
  });

  // niveles ligados (Tabla IV) y eigenfunciones a 12 kHz
  {
    const d = DATA.levels, L3 = d.levels['3'], L4 = d.levels['4'];
    const all = [...L3.lo, ...L3.hi, ...L4.lo, ...L4.hi, ...L3.table, ...L4.table, 1];
    const lo = Math.min(...all), hi = Math.max(...all), pad = (hi - lo) * 0.12;
    const tl = (n, Ln, c) => [
      { type: 'area', data: d.nu.map((x, i) => [x, Ln.lo[i], Ln.hi[i]]), color: c, opacity: 0.18 },
      { type: 'line', data: zip(d.nu, Ln.mid), color: c, name: `n = ${n}, este cálculo`, fmt: v => v.toFixed(4) },
      { type: 'points', hollow: true, color: c, data: zip(d.nu, Ln.table),
        tip: p => [[c, p[1].toFixed(2), `n = ${n}, Tabla IV a ${p[0]} kHz`], [c, Ln.mid[d.nu.indexOf(p[0])].toFixed(4), 'este cálculo']] },
    ];
    SPECS.levels = {
      title: 'Niveles ligados l = 2 (Tabla IV)', sub: 'la banda es lo que cambia según el interior (plano o Dirichlet, R = 10.5–12 km)',
      aria: 'Cociente −k̃² n²/α² frente a ν_a para n = 3 y 4: las curvas calculadas pasan por los valores de la Tabla IV.',
      legend: [['line', '--c1', 'n = 3'], ['line', '--c2', 'n = 4'], ['area', '--muted', 'banda del interior'], ['ring', '--muted', 'Tabla IV del paper']],
      x: { min: d.nu[0] - 0.3, max: d.nu[d.nu.length - 1] + 0.3, label: 'ν_{a} (kHz)', fmt: v => v + ' kHz' },
      y: { min: lo - pad, max: hi + pad, label: '−k̃_{n}^{2} n^{2} / α^{2}' },
      layers: [{ type: 'hline', at: 1, color: '--muted', dash: '4 3', label: 'hidrogénico, Ec. (23)', lx: d.nu[0] - 0.2 },
        ...tl(3, L3, '--c1'), ...tl(4, L4, '--c2')],
    };
    SPECS.psi = {
      title: 'Eigenfunciones a ν_{a} = 12 kHz', sub: 'como la Fig. 5 del paper; interior «plano», R = 10.5 km',
      aria: 'Potencial ΔV y eigenfunciones de los niveles n = 3 y n = 4 a 12 kHz: el pico de n = 3 está hacia 50 km y n = 4 tiene un nodo hacia 85 km.',
      legend: [['line', '--ink', 'ΔV/m_{a}^{2}, Ec. (22)'], ['line', '--c1', 'ψ, n = 3'], ['line', '--c2', 'ψ, n = 4']],
      x: { min: 0, max: 190, label: 'r (km)', fmt: v => 'r = ' + v.toFixed(0) + ' km' }, y: { min: -0.12, max: 0.06, label: 'energía / m_{a}^{2}' },
      layers: [
        { type: 'vline', at: d.R, color: '--muted', dash: '2 3', label: 'R', ly: -0.112 },
        { type: 'hline', at: d.psi['3'].k2, color: '--c1', width: 0.8 },
        { type: 'hline', at: d.psi['4'].k2, color: '--c2', width: 0.8 },
        { type: 'line', data: zip(d.r, d.dV), color: '--ink', width: 1.6, name: 'ΔV/m_{a}^{2}', fmt: v => fmt(v, 4) },
        { type: 'line', data: zip(d.r, d.psi['3'].y), color: '--c1' },
        { type: 'line', data: zip(d.r, d.psi['4'].y), color: '--c2' },
      ],
    };
  }

  // resonancia del modo f y las 52 frecuencias
  {
    const d = DATA.modes;
    const all = [...d.full, ...d.zl].filter(v => v > 0);
    const ymin = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(Math.min(...all)));
    const yt = [];
    for (let e = Math.log10(ymin); e <= 0; e += 2) yt.push([10 ** e, sci(10 ** e)]);
    SPECS.res = {
      title: 'Modo f, l = 2: la resonancia', sub: 'politropo de 1.4 M_{⊙}; el mínimo de la onda saliente marca el modo',
      aria: `Amplitud de la onda saliente frente a la frecuencia: mínimo en ${d.lmi}, el valor de Lindblom, Mendell e Ipser; Cowling da ${d.cow.toFixed(3)}; con la errata de signo, ${d.zlmin.toFixed(3)}.`,
      legend: [['line', '--c1', 'métrica dinámica (sistema extendido, sin axión)'], ['dash', '--c3', 'ídem, con el signo impreso por Zhao y Lattimer'], ['line', '--c2', 'Cowling (paso 5)']],
      x: { min: 0.6, max: 2.0, label: 'ω / √(M/R^{3})', fmt: v => 'ω = ' + v.toFixed(4) },
      y: { min: ymin, max: 2, log: true, ticks: yt, label: '|A_{out}|^{2} normalizada' }, ml: 50,
      layers: [
        { type: 'vline', at: d.lmi, color: '--muted', dash: '2 3', label: `LMI (1997): ${d.lmi}`, ly: ymin * 30 },
        { type: 'vline', at: d.cow, color: '--c2', width: 2, label: `Cowling: ${d.cow.toFixed(3)}`, ly: 0.12 },
        { type: 'line', data: zip(d.scan, d.zl), color: '--c3', dash: '5 3', name: 'con la errata', fmt: v => v.toExponential(1) },
        { type: 'line', data: zip(d.scan, d.full), color: '--c1', name: 'métrica dinámica', fmt: v => v.toExponential(1) },
        { type: 'text', x: d.zlmin, y: ymin * 4, dx: -6, anchor: 'end', label: `errata: ${d.zlmin.toFixed(3)}` },
      ],
    };
    const cols = ['--c2', '--c1', '--c1'], names = ['Cowling vs. YK', 'dinámica vs. YK', 'dinámica vs. LMI'];
    let x0 = 0;
    const layers = [{ type: 'hline', at: 0, color: '--muted', width: 1 }], ticks = [];
    let ext = 0;
    d.groups.forEach((gr, k) => {
      const data = gr.pts.map((p, i) => [x0 + i, p[0], p[1], gr.tags[i], p[2], p[3]]);
      ext = Math.max(ext, ...gr.pts.map(p => Math.abs(p[0]) + p[1]));
      layers.push({ type: 'points', err: true, hollow: k === 2, color: cols[k], data, r: 3.5,
        tip: p => [[cols[k], (p[1] >= 0 ? '+' : '−') + Math.abs(p[1]).toFixed(3) + ' %', names[k]], [null, p[3], ''],
          [null, `${p[4].toPrecision(5)} frente a ${p[5]}`, '']] });
      ticks.push([x0 + (gr.pts.length - 1) / 2, names[k]]);
      x0 += gr.pts.length + 4;
    });
    SPECS.cmp = {
      title: '52 frecuencias publicadas', sub: 'diferencia relativa; la barra es la precisión con que se publicó cada valor',
      aria: 'Diferencias relativas con 52 frecuencias publicadas: casi todas dentro de su precisión; las de Yoshida y Kojima en relatividad completa, dentro del 0.5 %.',
      x: { min: -2, max: x0 - 2, ticks, nogrid: true, label: '' }, mb: 30,
      y: { min: -ext * 1.15, max: ext * 1.15, label: 'este cálculo − referencia (%)' }, layers,
    };
  }

  // fondo con axión
  {
    const d = DATA.background, cols = ['--c2', '--c1'];
    const layers = [{ type: 'vline', at: 1, color: '--muted', dash: '2 3', label: 'superficie', ly: 0.97 }];
    d.bg.forEach((b, k) => layers.push({ type: 'area', data: d.x.map((x, i) => [x, 0, b.carrier[i]]), color: cols[k], opacity: 0.16 }));
    d.bg.forEach((b, k) => {
      layers.push({ type: 'line', data: zip(d.x, b.theta), color: cols[k], name: `θ_{0}/π, ${b.nu} kHz`, fmt: v => v.toFixed(3) });
      layers.push({ type: 'line', data: zip(d.x, b.carrier), color: cols[k], width: 0.01, name: `acoplo, ${b.nu} kHz`, fmt: v => v.toFixed(2) });
    });
    SPECS.bg = {
      title: 'Fondo con axión: dónde actúan los términos nuevos', sub: 'esquemático: politropo n = 1 de 1.4 M_{⊙} y 12 km, sin retroacción sobre la métrica',
      aria: 'θ₀/π frente a r/R para 5 y 15 kHz, con sombras donde el acoplo es grande: a 15 kHz, una capa entre 0.65 R y la superficie; a 5 kHz, media estrella.',
      legend: d.bg.map((b, k) => ['line', cols[k], `θ_{0}/π, ν_{a} = ${b.nu} kHz`]).concat([['area', '--muted', 'n_{b}|∂m*/∂θ| normalizado']]),
      x: { min: 0, max: 1.6, label: 'r / R', fmt: v => 'r = ' + v.toFixed(2) + ' R' }, y: { min: 0, max: 1.05, label: 'θ_{0}/π  ·  acoplo (sombra)' }, layers,
    };
  }

  // con axión en Cowling (paso 9): desplazamientos de las frecuencias y amortiguamiento
  if (DATA.axcow) {
    const d = DATA.axcow, lab = { f: 'f', p1: 'p_{1}', p2: 'p_{2}' };
    const X = { min: 2.3, max: 15.5, label: 'ν_{a} (kHz)', fmt: v => 'ν_a = ' + v + ' kHz', name: '' };
    d.modes.forEach(md => {
      const all = [...md.bg, ...md.cp, ...md.pbg.map(p => p[1]), ...md.pcp.map(p => p[1]), 0];
      const lo = Math.min(...all), hi = Math.max(...all), pad = (hi - lo) * 0.1;
      const pct = v => (v >= 0 ? '+' : '−') + Math.abs(v).toFixed(2) + ' %';
      SPECS['ax_' + md.name] = {
        title: `Modo ${lab[md.name]}`, sub: 'desplazamiento respecto a la estrella sin axión', h: 250,
        aria: `Desplazamiento del modo ${md.name} frente a la masa del axión: este cálculo y la secuela coinciden dentro de medio punto.`,
        legend: [['line', '--c2', 'solo fondo (Tabla I)'], ['line', '--c1', 'con δθ (Tabla II)'], ['ring', '--muted', 'secuela']],
        x: X, y: { min: lo - pad, max: hi + pad, label: 'ν/ν_{0} − 1 (%)' },
        layers: [
          { type: 'hline', at: 0, color: '--muted', width: 1 },
          { type: 'line', data: zip(d.nus, md.bg), color: '--c2', name: 'solo fondo', fmt: pct },
          { type: 'line', data: zip(d.nus, md.cp), color: '--c1', name: 'con δθ', fmt: pct },
          { type: 'points', hollow: true, color: '--c2', r: 3.5, data: md.pbg, tip: p => [['--c2', pct(p[1]), `secuela, solo fondo, ${p[0]} kHz`]] },
          { type: 'points', hollow: true, color: '--c1', r: 3.5, data: md.pcp, tip: p => [['--c1', pct(p[1]), `secuela, con δθ, ${p[0]} kHz`]] },
        ],
      };
    });
    const cols = { p1: '--c3', p2: '--ink' };
    const layers = [];
    d.modes.filter(md => md.name !== 'f').forEach(md => {
      const ours = d.nus.map((nu, i) => [nu, md.im[i]]).filter(p => p[1] > 1e-3);
      layers.unshift({ type: 'points', color: cols[md.name], hollow: true, r: 6, data: md.pim,
        tip: p => [[cols[md.name], p[1].toPrecision(2) + ' Hz', `${md.name}, secuela, ${p[0]} kHz`]] });
      layers.push({ type: 'points', color: cols[md.name], r: 3.5, data: ours,
        tip: p => [[cols[md.name], p[1].toPrecision(2) + ' Hz', `${md.name}, este cálculo, ${p[0]} kHz`],
          [null, (1e3 / (2 * PI * p[1])).toFixed(0) + ' ms', 'tiempo de amortiguamiento']] });
    });
    SPECS.ax_im = {
      title: 'Amortiguamiento por emisión de axiones', sub: '|Im ν|; τ_{a} = 1/(2π|Im ν|), de 12 ms a varios segundos', h: 250,
      aria: 'Amortiguamiento de p1 y p2 frente a la masa del axión: mismo orden de magnitud que la secuela, con el máximo de unos 13 Hz entre 5 y 6 kHz.',
      legend: [['dot', '--c3', 'p_{1}'], ['dot', '--ink', 'p_{2}'], ['dot', '--muted', 'este cálculo'], ['ring', '--muted', 'secuela']],
      x: X, y: { min: 0.03, max: 30, log: true, ticks: [[0.1, '0.1'], [1, '1'], [10, '10']], label: '|Im ν| (Hz)' }, layers,
    };
  }

  // etapa B (paso 10): con axión y métrica dinámica, frente a Cowling
  if (DATA.axgr && DATA.axcow) {
    const d = DATA.axgr, c = DATA.axcow, lab = { f: 'f', p1: 'p_{1}', p2: 'p_{2}' };
    const X = { min: 2.3, max: 15.5, label: 'ν_{a} (kHz)', fmt: v => 'ν_a = ' + v + ' kHz', name: '' };
    const pct = v => (v >= 0 ? '+' : '−') + Math.abs(v).toFixed(2) + ' %';
    d.modes.forEach((md, i) => {
      const cw = c.modes[i];
      const all = [...md.cp, ...md.bg, ...cw.cp, 0];
      const lo = Math.min(...all), hi = Math.max(...all), pad = (hi - lo) * 0.1;
      SPECS['gr_' + md.name] = {
        title: `Modo ${lab[md.name]}`, sub: `sin axión: ${d.gr0[i][0].toFixed(3)} kHz con la métrica dinámica, ${d.cow0[i].toFixed(3)} en Cowling`, h: 250,
        aria: `Desplazamiento del modo ${md.name} con la métrica dinámica frente a la masa del axión, comparado con Cowling.`,
        legend: [['line', '--c1', 'métrica dinámica, con δθ (nuevo)'], ['line', '--c2', 'métrica dinámica, solo fondo'], ['dash', '--muted', 'Cowling, con δθ (paso 9)']],
        x: X, y: { min: lo - pad, max: hi + pad, label: 'ν/ν_{0} − 1 (%)' },
        layers: [
          { type: 'hline', at: 0, color: '--muted', width: 1 },
          { type: 'line', data: zip(c.nus, cw.cp), color: '--muted', dash: '5 3', name: 'Cowling', fmt: pct },
          { type: 'line', data: zip(d.nus, md.bg), color: '--c2', name: 'solo fondo', fmt: pct },
          { type: 'line', data: zip(d.nus, md.cp), color: '--c1', name: 'con δθ', fmt: pct },
          { type: 'points', color: '--c1', r: 3.5, data: zip(d.nus, md.cp),
            tip: p => [['--c1', pct(p[1]), `con δθ, ${p[0]} kHz`], [null, md.re[d.nus.indexOf(p[0])].toFixed(3) + ' kHz', '']] },
        ],
      };
    });
    const cols = { f: '--c1', p1: '--c3', p2: '--ink' }, layers = [];
    c.modes.filter(md => md.name !== 'f').forEach(md => {
      const pts = c.nus.map((nu, i) => [nu, md.im[i]]).filter(p => p[1] > 1e-3);
      layers.push({ type: 'points', color: cols[md.name], hollow: true, r: 6, data: pts,
        tip: p => [[cols[md.name], p[1].toPrecision(2) + ' Hz', `${md.name}, Cowling (solo axiones), ${p[0]} kHz`]] });
    });
    d.modes.forEach(md => {
      const pts = d.nus.map((nu, i) => [nu, md.im[i]]).filter(p => p[1] > 1e-3);
      layers.push({ type: 'points', color: cols[md.name], r: 3.5, data: pts,
        tip: p => [[cols[md.name], p[1].toPrecision(3) + ' Hz', `${md.name}, métrica dinámica, ${p[0]} kHz`],
          [null, (1e3 / (2 * PI * p[1])).toPrecision(3) + ' ms', 'tiempo de amortiguamiento']] });
    });
    SPECS.gr_im = {
      title: 'Amortiguamiento total', sub: 'ondas gravitacionales y axiones a la vez; anillos: solo axiones en Cowling', h: 270,
      aria: 'Amortiguamiento de f, p1 y p2 con la métrica dinámica frente a la masa del axión, comparado con el de Cowling.',
      legend: [['dot', '--c1', 'f'], ['dot', '--c3', 'p_{1}'], ['dot', '--ink', 'p_{2}'], ['dot', '--muted', 'métrica dinámica'], ['ring', '--muted', 'Cowling']],
      x: X, y: { min: 1e-3, max: 30, log: true, ticks: [[0.001, '0.001'], [0.01, '0.01'], [0.1, '0.1'], [1, '1'], [10, '10']], label: '|Im ν| (Hz)' }, layers,
    };
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ montaje y redibujado
  const boxes = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-chart]')];
  const widths = new Map();
  const draw = b => { widths.set(b, b.clientWidth); render(b, SPECS[b.dataset.chart]); };
  boxes.forEach(draw);
  const ro = new ResizeObserver(es => es.forEach(e => {
    if (Math.abs(e.target.clientWidth - (widths.get(e.target) || 0)) > 2) draw(e.target);
  }));
  boxes.forEach(b => ro.observe(b));
  const redrawAll = () => boxes.forEach(draw);
  window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').addEventListener('change', redrawAll);
  new MutationObserver(redrawAll).observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-theme'] });

  // tabla de las 52 frecuencias
  const tb = document.getElementById('freqtable');
  if (tb) {
    const names = ['Cowling vs. Yoshida–Kojima', 'Métrica dinámica vs. Yoshida–Kojima', 'Métrica dinámica vs. Lindblom–Mendell–Ipser'];
    DATA.modes.groups.forEach((gr, k) => gr.pts.forEach((p, i) => {
      const tr = htmlEl('tr', '', tb);
      for (const [v, c] of [[i ? '' : names[k], ''], [gr.tags[i], ''], [p[2].toPrecision(5), 'num'], [String(p[3]), 'num'],
        [(p[0] >= 0 ? '+' : '−') + Math.abs(p[0]).toFixed(3), 'num'], ['±' + p[1].toFixed(3), 'num']])
        htmlEl('td', c, tr).textContent = v;
    }));
  }
})();
report/anim.js (856 líneas)
// Animaciones estilo 3Blue1Brown / Manim:
// 1) "De la acción a los modos, en seis ecuaciones" (escenas vectoriales en vivo + ecuaciones).
// 2) "Anatomía de un modo" (datos reales de los pasos 9 y 10 con retícula de espacio-tiempo, vectores de velocidad,
//    capa de transición, nodos radiales y osciloscopio de ringdown en tiempo real).
// Sin bibliotecas externas: Canvas 2D y CSS. Con prefers-reduced-motion, la animación empieza en pausa.
(() => {
  const DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('figdata').textContent);
  const REDUCE = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  const PAL = {
    bg: [14, 18, 28], star: [28, 43, 74], cond: [247, 217, 111],
    gwp: [88, 196, 221], gwn: [154, 114, 172],
    axp: [247, 217, 111], axn: [252, 98, 85],
    blue: '#58c4dd', yellow: '#f7d96f', green: '#83c167', red: '#fc6255', purple: '#9a72ac',
    ink: '#e6edf6', muted: '#8b97ab', grid: 'rgba(88, 196, 221, 0.14)'
  };

  function arrow(ctx, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, size = 6, lw = 1.6) {
    const dx = x2 - x1, dy = y2 - y1, len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    if (len < 1e-3) return;
    const ux = dx / len, uy = dy / len;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = lw;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
    ctx.lineTo(x2 - ux * size * 0.7, y2 - uy * size * 0.7);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x2, y2);
    ctx.lineTo(x2 - ux * size - uy * size * 0.52, y2 - uy * size + ux * size * 0.52);
    ctx.lineTo(x2 - ux * size + uy * size * 0.52, y2 - uy * size - ux * size * 0.52);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function glowStroke(ctx, color, width, glow = 8) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = width;
    ctx.shadowColor = color;
    ctx.shadowBlur = glow;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ 1. anatomía de un modo
  function modeAnim(root) {
    const gr = DATA.axgr, cw = DATA.axcow;
    if (!gr || !cw) return;
    const cv = root.querySelector('canvas'), ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
    const off = document.createElement('canvas'), octx = off.getContext('2d');
    const ui = {
      modes: root.querySelectorAll('[data-mode]'), metric: root.querySelectorAll('[data-metric]'),
      slider: root.querySelector('input[type=range]'), nu: root.querySelector('[data-out=nua]'),
      freq: root.querySelector('[data-out=freq]'), damp: root.querySelector('[data-out=damp]'),
      rad: root.querySelector('[data-out=rad]'), play: root.querySelector('[data-play]'),
    };
    const st = { mode: 2, idx: 1 + gr.nus.indexOf(5), dyn: true, playing: !REDUCE, t: 0, visible: true };
    ui.slider.max = gr.nus.length;
    ui.slider.value = st.idx;

    function current() {
      const i = st.mode, j = st.idx - 1, nua = j >= 0 ? gr.nus[j] : null;
      let re, im;
      if (st.dyn) {
        re = j >= 0 ? gr.modes[i].re[j] : gr.gr0[i][0];
        im = j >= 0 ? gr.modes[i].im[j] : gr.gr0[i][1];
      } else {
        re = j >= 0 ? gr.cow0[i] * (1 + cw.modes[i].cp[j] / 100) : gr.cow0[i];
        im = j >= 0 ? cw.modes[i].im[j] : 0;
      }
      const prof = j >= 0 ? cw.prof[j] : null;
      return { i, nua, re, im, prof, radiates: nua !== null && re > nua };
    }

    let W, H, R, cx, cy, S = 3, grid, img;
    function layout() {
      const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
      W = Math.max(300, root.querySelector('.stage-canvas').clientWidth);
      H = Math.round(Math.min(450, Math.max(310, W * 0.53)));
      cv.width = W * dpr; cv.height = H * dpr; cv.style.height = H + 'px';
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      R = Math.min(H * 0.235, W * 0.13); cx = W / 2; cy = H / 2 - 6;
      off.width = Math.ceil(W / S); off.height = Math.ceil(H / S);
      const n = off.width * off.height;
      grid = { rho: new Float32Array(n), c2: new Float32Array(n), side: new Int8Array(n) };
      for (let y = 0; y < off.height; y++) for (let x = 0; x < off.width; x++) {
        const dx = x * S - cx, dy = y * S - cy, k = y * off.width + x;
        const rho = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        grid.rho[k] = rho; grid.c2[k] = rho > 0 ? (dy * dy) / (rho * rho) : 1;
        grid.side[k] = dx < 0 ? -1 : 1;
      }
      img = octx.createImageData(off.width, off.height);
    }

    // perfil radial del desplazamiento (estilizado): f sin nodos, p1 uno (x≈0.67), p2 dos (x≈0.46, 0.89)
    const xi = [x => x, x => x * (1 - 2.2 * x * x) / -1.2, x => x * (1 - 6 * x * x + 6 * x ** 4)];
    const nodes = [[], [0.674], [0.459, 0.888]];
    const mix = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;

    function transitionRadius(prof) {
      if (!prof) return null;
      for (let i = 0; i < prof.length - 1; i++) {
        if (prof[i] >= 0.5 && prof[i + 1] < 0.5) {
          const u = (prof[i] - 0.5) / (prof[i] - prof[i + 1]);
          return (i + u) * 0.05;
        }
      }
      return 0.72;
    }

    function draw() {
      const m = current();
      const nuRef = 1.961;
      const Lref = 2.4 * R;
      const lamGW = Lref * nuRef / m.re;
      let lamA = null, ell = null;
      if (m.nua !== null) {
        if (m.radiates) lamA = Lref * nuRef / Math.sqrt(m.re ** 2 - m.nua ** 2);
        else ell = Lref * nuRef / (2 * Math.PI * Math.sqrt(m.nua ** 2 - m.re ** 2));
      }
      const ph = st.t * 2 * Math.PI / 1.4;
      const amp = 0.075, cosw = Math.cos(ph), sinw = Math.sin(ph);
      const d = img.data, prof = m.prof;

      for (let k = 0; k < grid.rho.length; k++) {
        const rho = grid.rho[k], c2 = grid.c2[k], P2 = 1.5 * c2 - 0.5;
        const rb = R * (1 + amp * xi[m.i](1) * P2 * cosw);
        let c = PAL.bg, a = 0, col = null;
        const o = k * 4;
        if (rho <= rb) {
          const x = rho / R;
          let th = 0;
          if (prof) {
            const u = Math.min(x / 0.05, prof.length - 1.001), i0 = Math.floor(u);
            th = mix(prof[i0], prof[i0 + 1], u - i0);
          }
          const tone = 0.15 + 0.85 * th;
          const disp = 0.5 + 0.5 * xi[m.i](Math.min(x, 1)) * P2 * cosw;
          for (let q = 0; q < 3; q++) {
            d[o + q] = mix(mix(PAL.star[q], PAL.cond[q], th ** 1.5 * 0.78), 255, 0.12 * disp) * (0.7 + 0.3 * tone);
          }
          d[o + 3] = 255;
          continue;
        }
        const s = rho - R;
        if (grid.side[k] < 0) {
          if (st.dyn) {
            const v = (1 - c2) * Math.cos(ph - 2 * Math.PI * s / lamGW) * Math.min(1, 1.6 * R / rho);
            col = v > 0 ? PAL.gwp : PAL.gwn; a = Math.min(1, Math.abs(v)) * 0.85;
          }
        } else if (m.nua !== null) {
          let v = 0;
          if (lamA) v = P2 * Math.cos(ph - 2 * Math.PI * s / lamA) * Math.min(1, 1.6 * R / rho);
          else v = P2 * cosw * Math.exp(-s / ell);
          if (prof) {
            const x = rho / R, u = Math.min(x / 0.05, prof.length - 1.001), i0 = Math.floor(u);
            const th = mix(prof[i0], prof[i0 + 1], u - i0);
            c = PAL.bg.map((v0, q) => mix(v0, PAL.cond[q], 0.35 * th));
          }
          col = v > 0 ? PAL.axp : PAL.axn; a = Math.min(1, Math.abs(v)) * 0.82;
        }
        for (let q = 0; q < 3; q++) d[o + q] = col ? mix(c[q], col[q], a) : c[q];
        d[o + 3] = 255;
      }
      octx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
      ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
      ctx.drawImage(off, 0, 0, off.width * S, off.height * S);

      // Retícula de espacio-tiempo 3Blue1Brown (en la izquierda se curva con h+ si métrica dinámica, y queda rígida en Cowling)
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = st.dyn ? 'rgba(88, 196, 221, 0.19)' : 'rgba(139, 151, 171, 0.12)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let gx = -5; gx <= -1; gx++) {
        const x0 = cx + gx * R * 0.62;
        if (x0 < 12) continue;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let gy = -24; gy <= 24; gy++) {
          const y0 = cy + gy * (H / 52);
          const dx = x0 - cx, dy = y0 - cy, rho = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
          let wx = x0, wy = y0;
          if (st.dyn && rho > R * 1.05) {
            const c2 = (dy * dy) / (rho * rho);
            const h = 4.5 * (1 - c2) * Math.cos(ph - 2 * Math.PI * (rho - R) / lamGW) * Math.min(1, 1.5 * R / rho);
            wx += h * (dx / rho);
            wy -= h * (dy / rho);
          }
          gy === -24 ? ctx.moveTo(wx, wy) : ctx.lineTo(wx, wy);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      for (let gy = -3; gy <= 3; gy++) {
        const y0 = cy + gy * R * 0.58;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let gx = -32; gx <= 0; gx++) {
          const x0 = cx + gx * (W / 68);
          const dx = x0 - cx, dy = y0 - cy, rho = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
          if (rho < R * 1.04) { ctx.moveTo(x0, y0); continue; }
          let wx = x0, wy = y0;
          if (st.dyn) {
            const c2 = (dy * dy) / (rho * rho);
            const h = 4.5 * (1 - c2) * Math.cos(ph - 2 * Math.PI * (rho - R) / lamGW) * Math.min(1, 1.5 * R / rho);
            wx += h * (dx / rho);
            wy -= h * (dy / rho);
          }
          gx === -32 ? ctx.moveTo(wx, wy) : ctx.lineTo(wx, wy);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();

      // Divisor central vertical sutil
      ctx.save();
      ctx.setLineDash([3, 5]);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(230, 237, 246, 0.18)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx, 12); ctx.lineTo(cx, cy - R * 1.15);
      ctx.moveTo(cx, cy + R * 1.15); ctx.lineTo(cx, H - 12);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();

      // Capas del fluido + superficie con brillo Manim
      for (const r0 of [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1]) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let a2 = 0; a2 <= 72; a2++) {
          const t = a2 / 72 * 2 * Math.PI, c = Math.cos(t), P2 = 1.5 * c * c - 0.5;
          const rr = R * (r0 + amp * xi[m.i](r0) * P2 * cosw);
          const X = cx + rr * Math.sin(t), Y = cy - rr * c;
          a2 ? ctx.lineTo(X, Y) : ctx.moveTo(X, Y);
        }
        if (r0 === 1) {
          glowStroke(ctx, 'rgba(230,237,246,0.95)', 2.2, 6);
        } else {
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(14,18,28,0.45)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }

      // Nodos radiales de p1 / p2 en cian punteado (#58c4dd)
      ctx.save();
      ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
      ctx.strokeStyle = PAL.blue;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
      for (const rn of nodes[m.i]) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(cx, cy, R * rn, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();

      // Vectores de velocidad cuadrupolar del fluido dentro de la estrella (estilo 3B1B)
      const vphase = -sinw;
      if (Math.abs(vphase) > 0.12) {
        const rSample = m.i === 0 ? 0.62 : m.i === 1 ? 0.84 : 0.68;
        const sgn = Math.sign(xi[m.i](rSample)) * vphase;
        for (const ang of [0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI, 1.5 * Math.PI]) {
          const c = Math.cos(ang), s = Math.sin(ang), P2 = 1.5 * c * c - 0.5;
          const rBase = R * rSample;
          const x1 = cx + rBase * s, y1 = cy - rBase * c;
          const dr = 11 * P2 * sgn;
          arrow(ctx, x1, y1, x1 + dr * s, y1 - dr * c, 'rgba(230,237,246,0.85)', 4.5, 1.3);
        }
      }

      // Anillo y llamada vectorial a la capa de transición (θ₀ ≈ π/2)
      const xTrans = transitionRadius(prof);
      if (xTrans !== null && W > 520) {
        const rT = R * xTrans;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.setLineDash([2, 3]);
        ctx.strokeStyle = PAL.yellow;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(cx, cy, rT, -0.7, 0.7);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();

        const tx = cx + rT * Math.cos(-0.42), ty = cy + rT * Math.sin(-0.42);
        const lx = cx + R * 1.48, ly = cy - R * 0.92;
        arrow(ctx, lx - 4, ly + 4, tx + 3, ty - 2, PAL.yellow, 5.5, 1.4);
        ctx.font = '500 11.5px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace';
        ctx.fillStyle = PAL.yellow;
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        ctx.fillText('capa de transición (∂m*/∂θ ≠ 0)', lx, ly);
      }

      // Rótulos superiores estilo 3B1B
      ctx.font = '600 13px "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.blue; ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.fillText('← Ondas gravitacionales (h₊)', 14, 24);
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.yellow; ctx.textAlign = 'right';
      ctx.fillText('Radiación axiónica (δθ) →', W - 14, 24);

      ctx.font = '400 12px "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.muted;
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.fillText(st.dyn ? 'Métrica dinámica: retícula oscila (∝ sin²ϑ)' : 'Cowling: métrica congelada (retícula fija)', 14, 42);
      ctx.textAlign = 'right';
      ctx.fillText(m.nua === null ? 'Sin condensado axiónico' : m.radiates ? `ν (${m.re.toFixed(2)}) > νₐ (${m.nua}): onda escapa` : `ν (${m.re.toFixed(2)}) < νₐ (${m.nua}): nube ligada`, W - 14, 42);

      // Etiqueta de nodos radiales debajo de la estrella
      const nodeLabel = ['modo f: 0 nodos radiales', 'modo p₁: 1 nodo radial (círculo azul)', 'modo p₂: 2 nodos radiales'][m.i];
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.font = '500 11.5px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace';
      ctx.fillStyle = nodes[m.i].length ? PAL.blue : PAL.ink;
      ctx.fillText(nodeLabel, cx, cy + R * 1.28);

      // Mini-osciloscopio Manim en esquina inferior izquierda: amortiguamiento temporal e^(-t/τ) cos(ωt)
      if (W > 560) {
        const bx = 14, by = H - 68, bw = 175, bh = 44;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20, 27, 39, 0.86)';
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#2c3850';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect ? ctx.roundRect(bx, by, bw, bh, 5) : ctx.rect(bx, by, bw, bh);
        ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();

        const decay = m.im > 1e-4 ? Math.min(2.6, 0.32 * Math.log10(1 + m.im * 18)) : 0;
        const midY = by + bh / 2, ampY = bh * 0.36;

        if (decay > 0.01) {
          ctx.setLineDash([2, 2]);
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(252, 98, 85, 0.55)';
          for (const sgn of [-1, 1]) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let u = 0; u <= bw - 16; u += 3) {
              const env = Math.exp(-decay * (u / (bw - 16)));
              const px = bx + 8 + u, py = midY + sgn * ampY * env;
              u === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(px, py) : ctx.lineTo(px, py);
            }
            ctx.stroke();
          }
          ctx.setLineDash([]);
        }

        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let u = 0; u <= bw - 16; u += 1.5) {
          const frac = u / (bw - 16);
          const env = Math.exp(-decay * frac);
          const y = midY - ampY * env * Math.cos(frac * 6.5 * Math.PI - ph);
          u === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(bx + 8 + u, y) : ctx.lineTo(bx + 8 + u, y);
        }
        glowStroke(ctx, m.radiates ? PAL.yellow : PAL.blue, 1.6, 4);

        ctx.font = '500 10px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace';
        ctx.fillStyle = PAL.muted;
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        ctx.fillText(decay > 0.01 ? 'ringdown: e^(−t/τ) cos(ωt)' : 'sin amortiguamiento (τ = ∞)', bx + 6, by - 5);
        ctx.restore();
      }

      if (W > 720) {
        ctx.font = '400 11.5px "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif';
        ctx.fillStyle = PAL.muted;
        ctx.textAlign = 'right';
        ctx.fillText('distancias exteriores comprimidas · proporción de longitudes de onda real', W - 14, H - 12);
      }
    }

    function readout() {
      const m = current(), lab = ['f', 'p₁', 'p₂'][m.i];
      ui.nu.textContent = m.nua === null ? 'sin axión' : `νₐ = ${m.nua} kHz`;
      ui.freq.textContent = `${lab}: ${m.re.toFixed(3)} kHz`;
      if (m.im > 1e-3) {
        const tau = 1 / (2 * Math.PI * m.im);
        ui.damp.textContent = `|Im ν| = ${m.im < 0.1 ? m.im.toPrecision(2) : m.im.toFixed(2)} Hz · τ = ${tau >= 1 ? tau.toFixed(2) + ' s' : (tau * 1e3).toPrecision(3) + ' ms'}`;
      } else ui.damp.textContent = 'sin amortiguamiento';
      ui.rad.textContent = m.nua === null ? '' : m.radiates ? 'radia axiones' : 'no radia axiones';
      ui.modes.forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(+b.dataset.mode === st.mode)));
      ui.metric.forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String((b.dataset.metric === 'dyn') === st.dyn)));
      ui.play.textContent = st.playing ? 'Pausa' : 'Animar';
      ui.play.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(st.playing));
    }

    let last = null;
    function frame(ts) {
      if (last !== null && st.playing) st.t += Math.min(0.05, (ts - last) / 1000);
      last = ts;
      if (st.visible) draw();
      if (st.playing && st.visible) requestAnimationFrame(frame); else last = null;
    }
    const kick = () => { readout(); if (!st.playing || !st.visible) draw(); else if (last === null) requestAnimationFrame(frame); };
    ui.modes.forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => { st.mode = +b.dataset.mode; kick(); }));
    ui.metric.forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => { st.dyn = b.dataset.metric === 'dyn'; kick(); }));
    ui.slider.addEventListener('input', () => { st.idx = +ui.slider.value; kick(); });
    ui.play.addEventListener('click', () => { st.playing = !st.playing; readout(); if (st.playing) requestAnimationFrame(frame); });
    new IntersectionObserver(es => { st.visible = es[0].isIntersecting; if (st.visible && st.playing && last === null) requestAnimationFrame(frame); })
      .observe(cv);
    let lastW = 0;
    new ResizeObserver(() => {
      const w = root.querySelector('.stage-canvas').clientWidth;
      if (Math.abs(w - lastW) > 1) { lastW = w; layout(); draw(); }
    }).observe(root.querySelector('.stage-canvas'));
    layout(); readout(); draw();
    if (st.playing) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ 2. cadena de ecuaciones (6 escenas Manim)
  function stepper(root) {
    const steps = [...root.querySelectorAll('.step')], dots = [...root.querySelectorAll('.rail button:not([data-chain-play])')];
    const prev = root.querySelector('[data-prev]'), next = root.querySelector('[data-next]');
    const playBtn = root.querySelector('[data-chain-play]');
    const cv = root.querySelector('canvas.chain-cv');
    const ctx = cv ? cv.getContext('2d') : null;
    let k = 0, t = 0, stepAnim = 1, playing = !REDUCE, visible = true, last = null, W = 600, H = 210;

    function layout() {
      if (!cv) return;
      const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
      W = Math.max(280, cv.parentElement.clientWidth);
      H = W < 520 ? 195 : 215;
      cv.width = W * dpr; cv.height = H * dpr; cv.style.height = H + 'px';
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    }

    function drawBackgroundGrid() {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#0b0f18';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(88, 196, 221, 0.06)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      const step = 28;
      for (let x = (W % step) / 2; x < W; x += step) {
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, H); ctx.stroke();
      }
      for (let y = (H % step) / 2; y < H; y += step) {
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); ctx.stroke();
      }
    }

    // Escena 0: Acción (Gravedad + Fluido + Axión conectados por m*(a))
    function scene0(ph) {
      const y = H * 0.52, x1 = W * 0.2, x2 = W * 0.5, x3 = W * 0.8;
      for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let u = -38; u <= 38; u += 4) {
          const r2 = u * u + (i * 13) ** 2;
          const dip = 14 * Math.exp(-r2 / 900) * (1 + 0.15 * Math.sin(ph));
          const px = x1 + u, py = y + i * 12 + dip;
          u === -38 ? ctx.moveTo(px, py) : ctx.lineTo(px, py);
        }
        glowStroke(ctx, PAL.blue, 1.5, 4);
      }
      const rCore = 28 + 2.5 * Math.sin(ph * 1.3);
      const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(x2, y, 4, x2, y, rCore * 1.25);
      grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(131, 193, 103, 0.85)');
      grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(131, 193, 103, 0.05)');
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x2, y, rCore * 1.25, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x2, y, rCore, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      glowStroke(ctx, PAL.green, 2, 6);

      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let u = -42; u <= 42; u += 2) {
        const px = x3 + u;
        const py = y - 20 * Math.sin(u * 0.14 - ph * 1.6) * Math.exp(-u * u / 1800);
        u === -42 ? ctx.moveTo(px, py) : ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      glowStroke(ctx, PAL.yellow, 2.2, 8);

      arrow(ctx, x1 + 46, y, x2 - 38, y, PAL.blue, 6, 1.6);
      arrow(ctx, x2 - 38, y, x1 + 46, y, PAL.blue, 6, 1.6);
      arrow(ctx, x2 + 38, y, x3 - 48, y, PAL.yellow, 6, 1.8);
      arrow(ctx, x3 - 48, y, x2 + 38, y, PAL.yellow, 6, 1.8);

      ctx.font = '600 12.5px "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.blue; ctx.fillText('Gravedad', x1, 26);
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.green; ctx.fillText('Fluido nuclear', x2, 26);
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.yellow; ctx.fillText('Campo axiónico', x3, 26);

      ctx.font = '500 11.5px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace';
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.muted;
      ctx.fillText('curvatura ↔ T_μν', (x1 + x2) / 2, y - 12);
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.yellow;
      ctx.fillText('acoplo m*(a)', (x2 + x3) / 2, y - 12);
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.muted;
      ctx.fillText('Einstein–Hilbert', x1, H - 16);
      ctx.fillText('materia bariónica', x2, H - 16);
      ctx.fillText('Klein–Gordon', x3, H - 16);
    }

    // Escena 1: Fondo (V_eff invierte su mínimo a θ=π + perfil radial θ₀(r))
    function scene1(ph) {
      const mid = W * 0.48;
      const lx0 = 36, lx1 = mid - 24, ly0 = H - 34, ly1 = 42, lw = lx1 - lx0, lh = ly0 - ly1;
      arrow(ctx, lx0, ly0, lx1 + 8, ly0, PAL.muted, 5, 1.2);
      arrow(ctx, lx0 + lw / 2, ly0 + 6, lx0 + lw / 2, ly1 - 6, PAL.muted, 5, 1.2);

      ctx.save();
      ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i <= 80; i++) {
        const th = (i / 80 * 2 - 1) * Math.PI;
        const v = 0.55 * (1 - Math.cos(th));
        const px = lx0 + (i / 80) * lw, py = ly0 - v * lh * 0.75 - 6;
        i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(px, py) : ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = PAL.blue; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6; ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();

      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i <= 80; i++) {
        const th = (i / 80 * 2 - 1) * Math.PI;
        const v = 0.12 + 0.68 * (1 + Math.cos(th)) / 2;
        const px = lx0 + (i / 80) * lw, py = ly0 - v * lh * 0.78;
        i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(px, py) : ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      glowStroke(ctx, PAL.yellow, 2.2, 6);

      const bx = lx1 - 2 + 2 * Math.sin(ph * 2), by = ly0 - 0.12 * lh * 0.78;
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.yellow;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bx, by, 5, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.fill();

      ctx.font = '600 12px "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.yellow; ctx.fillText('Interior (n > n_c): mín. en θ = π', lx0, 24);
      ctx.font = '500 11px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace';
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.blue; ctx.fillText('Fuera: mín. en θ = 0', lx0, 40);
      ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillStyle = PAL.muted;
      ctx.fillText('−π', lx0 + 4, ly0 + 16);
      ctx.fillText('0', lx0 + lw / 2, ly0 + 16);
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.yellow; ctx.fillText('+π', lx1 - 2, ly0 + 16);

      const rx0 = mid + 24, rx1 = W - 26, rw = rx1 - rx0;
      const prof = (DATA.axcow && DATA.axcow.prof) ? DATA.axcow.prof[5] : null;
      const rSurf = rx0 + (1 / 2.2) * rw;

      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(247, 217, 111, 0.14)';
      ctx.fillRect(rSurf - rw * 0.11, ly1, rw * 0.14, lh);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.setLineDash([3, 4]);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(230,237,246,0.35)';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(rSurf, ly1); ctx.lineTo(rSurf, ly0); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();

      arrow(ctx, rx0, ly0, rx1 + 8, ly0, PAL.muted, 5, 1.2);
      arrow(ctx, rx0, ly0, rx0, ly1 - 6, PAL.muted, 5, 1.2);

      ctx.beginPath();
      const N = 44;
      for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
        const u = i / N;
        const val = prof ? prof[i] : 1 / (1 + Math.exp((u - 0.42) * 18));
        const px = rx0 + u * rw, py = ly0 - val * (lh - 12);
        i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(px, py) : ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      glowStroke(ctx, PAL.yellow, 2.4, 7);

      ctx.font = '600 12px "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'left'; ctx.fillStyle = PAL.ink;
      ctx.fillText('Perfil estático θ₀(r)', rx0, 24);
      ctx.font = '500 11px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace';
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.yellow;
      ctx.fillText('θ₀ ≈ π (condensado)', rx0 + 8, ly1 + 22);
      ctx.fillText('capa', rSurf - 16, ly1 + 12);
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.muted;
      ctx.fillText('r = R', rSurf - 14, ly0 + 16);
      ctx.fillText('r →', rx1 - 14, ly0 + 16);
    }

    // Escena 2: Cowling (El fluido agita al axión solo en la capa de transición)
    function scene2(ph) {
      const x0 = 42, x1 = W - 32, yMid = H * 0.56, w = x1 - x0;
      const xLayer = x0 + w * 0.44, wLayer = w * 0.11;

      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(xLayer - wLayer, 0, xLayer + wLayer, 0);
      g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(247, 217, 111, 0)');
      g.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(247, 217, 111, 0.25)');
      g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(247, 217, 111, 0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.fillRect(xLayer - wLayer, 32, wLayer * 2, H - 56);

      arrow(ctx, x0, yMid, x1 + 8, yMid, PAL.muted, 5, 1.2);

      ctx.beginPath();
      const iMax = Math.floor(w * 0.48);
      for (let u = 0; u <= iMax; u += 2) {
        const frac = u / iMax;
        const y = yMid - 34 * Math.sin(frac * 2 * Math.PI) * Math.cos(ph * 1.8);
        u === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(x0 + u, y) : ctx.lineTo(x0 + u, y);
      }
      glowStroke(ctx, PAL.green, 2.0, 5);

      ctx.save();
      ctx.setLineDash([3, 3]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let u = 0; u <= w; u += 3) {
        const px = x0 + u;
        const bell = Math.exp(-((px - xLayer) ** 2) / ((wLayer * 0.55) ** 2));
        const py = yMid - bell * 54;
        u === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(px, py) : ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = PAL.yellow; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();

      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let u = Math.floor(w * 0.36); u <= w; u += 2) {
        const px = x0 + u;
        const env = 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-(px - (xLayer - 14)) * 0.18));
        const decay = Math.min(1, 90 / Math.max(60, px - xLayer));
        const py = yMid - 38 * env * decay * Math.cos((px - xLayer) * 0.14 - ph * 1.8);
        u === Math.floor(w * 0.36) ? ctx.moveTo(px, py) : ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      glowStroke(ctx, PAL.yellow, 2.3, 7);

      ctx.font = '600 12px "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.green; ctx.fillText('Interior: vibración del fluido', x0, 24);
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.yellow; ctx.fillText('Capa de transición: acoplo activo', xLayer, 24);
      ctx.textAlign = 'right';
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.yellow; ctx.fillText('Exterior: onda δθ escapa si ω > m_a →', x1, 24);

      ctx.font = '500 11px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillStyle = PAL.muted;
      ctx.fillText('centro (r=0)', x0 + 28, H - 12);
      ctx.fillText('superficie (r=R)', xLayer + 12, H - 12);
      ctx.fillText('espacio exterior (r > R)', x0 + w * 0.78, H - 12);
    }

    // Escena 3: Más allá de Cowling (Comparación directa: Cowling vs Métrica dinámica)
    function scene3(ph) {
      const cx1 = W * 0.26, cx2 = W * 0.74, cy = H * 0.56, r0 = 30;
      const cosw = Math.cos(ph * 1.8);

      for (const [cx, dyn, title, sub, col] of [
        [cx1, false, 'Cowling (métrica congelada)', 'estrella vibra · espacio-tiempo fijo', PAL.muted],
        [cx2, true, 'Métrica dinámica (Regge–Wheeler)', 'el espacio-tiempo oscila y emite ondas', PAL.blue]
      ]) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = dyn ? 'rgba(88, 196, 221, 0.28)' : 'rgba(139, 151, 171, 0.16)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        for (let gx = -3; gx <= 3; gx++) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          for (let gy = -20; gy <= 20; gy += 2) {
            const dx = gx * 22, dy = gy * 3.4, rho = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
            let wx = cx + dx, wy = cy + dy;
            if (dyn && rho > r0 * 0.9) {
              const c2 = (dy * dy) / (rho * rho + 1);
              const h = 5.2 * (1 - c2) * Math.cos(ph * 1.8 - (rho - r0) * 0.16);
              wx += h * (dx / (rho + 1)); wy -= h * (dy / (rho + 1));
            }
            gy === -20 ? ctx.moveTo(wx, wy) : ctx.lineTo(wx, wy);
          }
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        if (dyn) {
          for (let ring = 0; ring < 3; ring++) {
            const rr = r0 + 10 + ((ph * 18 + ring * 26) % 78);
            const alpha = Math.max(0, 1 - (rr - r0) / 82) * 0.65;
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(88, 196, 221, ${alpha.toFixed(2)})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, rr * 1.12, rr * 0.88, 0, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let a = 0; a <= 60; a++) {
          const ang = (a / 60) * 2 * Math.PI, c = Math.cos(ang), P2 = 1.5 * c * c - 0.5;
          const rr = r0 * (1 + 0.14 * P2 * cosw);
          const px = cx + rr * Math.sin(ang), py = cy - rr * c;
          a === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(px, py) : ctx.lineTo(px, py);
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(28, 43, 74, 0.9)'; ctx.fill();
        glowStroke(ctx, dyn ? PAL.blue : PAL.ink, 2, 5);

        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.font = '600 12.5px "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif';
        ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.fillText(title, cx, 24);
        ctx.font = '400 11.5px "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif';
        ctx.fillStyle = PAL.muted; ctx.fillText(sub, cx, H - 12);
      }
    }

    // Escena 4: Sistema extendido (Diagrama de acoplo Lindblom-Detweiler + términos nuevos en amarillo)
    function scene4(ph) {
      const yBox = H * 0.48, bw = Math.min(155, W * 0.25), bh = 56;
      const x1 = W * 0.19, x2 = W * 0.5, x3 = W * 0.81;

      function box(cx, title, vars, col) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20, 27, 39, 0.95)';
        ctx.strokeStyle = col;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
        ctx.shadowColor = col; ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect ? ctx.roundRect(cx - bw / 2, yBox - bh / 2, bw, bh, 7) : ctx.rect(cx - bw / 2, yBox - bh / 2, bw, bh);
        ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.font = '600 12.5px "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif';
        ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.fillText(title, cx, yBox - 6);
        ctx.font = '500 11px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace';
        ctx.fillStyle = PAL.ink; ctx.fillText(vars, cx, yBox + 14);
      }

      arrow(ctx, x1 + bw / 2 + 4, yBox - 8, x2 - bw / 2 - 4, yBox - 8, PAL.blue, 5.5, 1.6);
      arrow(ctx, x2 - bw / 2 - 4, yBox + 8, x1 + bw / 2 + 4, yBox + 8, PAL.blue, 5.5, 1.6);

      arrow(ctx, x2 + bw / 2 + 4, yBox - 8, x3 - bw / 2 - 4, yBox - 8, PAL.yellow, 5.5, 2.0);
      arrow(ctx, x3 - bw / 2 - 4, yBox + 8, x2 + bw / 2 + 4, yBox + 8, PAL.yellow, 5.5, 2.0);

      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = PAL.yellow;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.shadowColor = PAL.yellow; ctx.shadowBlur = 7;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x1, yBox + bh / 2 + 2);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x2, H - 8, x3, yBox + bh / 2 + 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();

      const u = 0.5 + 0.45 * Math.sin(ph * 1.6);
      const px = (1 - u) ** 2 * x1 + 2 * (1 - u) * u * x2 + u ** 2 * x3;
      const py = (1 - u) ** 2 * (yBox + bh / 2 + 2) + 2 * (1 - u) * u * (H - 8) + u ** 2 * (yBox + bh / 2 + 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.yellow;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, 4.5, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.fill();

      box(x1, 'Métrica (LD)', 'H₁, K, H₀', PAL.blue);
      box(x2, 'Fluido (LD)', 'W, X, V', PAL.green);
      box(x3, 'Axión (KG)', 'δθ, δθ′', PAL.yellow);

      ctx.font = '500 11px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.blue;
      ctx.fillText('Lindblom–Detweiler (1983)', (x1 + x2) / 2, 26);
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.yellow;
      ctx.fillText('acoplo fluido–axión', (x2 + x3) / 2, 26);
      ctx.fillText('términos nuevos de acoplo directo métrica–axión (en amarillo abajo)', x2, H - 6);
    }

    // Escena 5: Modos cuasinormales (Plano complejo ω + dos canales de amortiguamiento)
    function scene5(ph) {
      const mid = W * 0.48;
      const lx0 = 40, lx1 = mid - 20, lyTop = 36, lyBot = H - 28;
      arrow(ctx, lx0, lyTop + 14, lx1 + 6, lyTop + 14, PAL.muted, 5, 1.3);
      arrow(ctx, lx0 + 12, lyTop, lx0 + 12, lyBot + 6, PAL.muted, 5, 1.3);

      const xThresh = lx0 + (lx1 - lx0) * 0.48;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(247, 217, 111, 0.09)';
      ctx.fillRect(xThresh, lyTop + 14, lx1 - xThresh, lyBot - lyTop - 14);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
      ctx.strokeStyle = PAL.yellow;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(xThresh, lyTop + 4); ctx.lineTo(xThresh, lyBot); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();

      const pts = [
        { x: lx0 + (lx1 - lx0) * 0.26, y: lyTop + 42, col: PAL.blue, lab: 'f (solo GW)' },
        { x: lx0 + (lx1 - lx0) * 0.66, y: lyTop + 68, col: PAL.yellow, lab: 'p₁ (GW + axión)' },
        { x: lx0 + (lx1 - lx0) * 0.86, y: lyTop + 108, col: PAL.red, lab: 'p₂ (τ ≈ 12 ms)' },
      ];
      for (const p of pts) {
        ctx.fillStyle = p.col;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 4.8 + 1.2 * Math.sin(ph * 2), 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.fill();
        ctx.font = '500 11px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace';
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        ctx.fillText(p.lab, p.x - 18, p.y - 9);
      }
      ctx.font = '600 12px "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.ink; ctx.fillText('Plano complejo (Re ν, Im ν)', lx0, 22);
      ctx.font = '500 11px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace';
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.yellow; ctx.fillText('umbral Re ν = νₐ', xThresh + 4, lyBot - 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.muted; ctx.fillText('−Im ν ↓', lx0 + 18, lyBot - 4);

      const rx0 = mid + 24, rx1 = W - 24, ryMid = H * 0.54, rw = rx1 - rx0;
      arrow(ctx, rx0, ryMid, rx1 + 6, ryMid, PAL.muted, 5, 1.2);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.setLineDash([3, 3]);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(252, 98, 85, 0.6)';
      for (const sgn of [-1, 1]) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let u = 0; u <= rw; u += 3) {
          const env = 54 * Math.exp(-2.1 * (u / rw));
          u === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(rx0 + u, ryMid + sgn * env) : ctx.lineTo(rx0 + u, ryMid + sgn * env);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();

      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let u = 0; u <= rw; u += 1.5) {
        const frac = u / rw;
        const y = ryMid - 54 * Math.exp(-2.1 * frac) * Math.cos(frac * 7.5 * Math.PI - ph * 2.2);
        u === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(rx0 + u, y) : ctx.lineTo(rx0 + u, y);
      }
      glowStroke(ctx, PAL.blue, 2.2, 6);

      ctx.font = '600 12px "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'left'; ctx.fillStyle = PAL.ink;
      ctx.fillText('Modo cuasinormal: vibración amortiguada', rx0, 22);
      ctx.font = '500 11px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace';
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.red;
      ctx.fillText('envolvente exponencial: 1/τ = 2π |Im ν|', rx0 + 6, H - 14);
    }

    const scenes = [scene0, scene1, scene2, scene3, scene4, scene5];

    function draw() {
      if (!ctx) return;
      drawBackgroundGrid();
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, stepAnim);
      scenes[k](t);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    function frame(ts) {
      if (last !== null) {
        const dt = Math.min(0.05, (ts - last) / 1000);
        if (playing) t += dt;
        if (stepAnim < 1) stepAnim = Math.min(1, stepAnim + dt * 3.2);
      }
      last = ts;
      if (visible) draw();
      if ((playing || stepAnim < 1) && visible) requestAnimationFrame(frame); else last = null;
    }

    function show(n) {
      k = (n + steps.length) % steps.length;
      stepAnim = 0.15;
      steps.forEach((s, i) => { s.classList.toggle('on', i === k); s.setAttribute('aria-hidden', String(i !== k)); });
      dots.forEach((d, i) => { d.setAttribute('aria-current', i === k ? 'step' : 'false'); d.classList.toggle('done', i < k); });
      draw();
      if (last === null && visible) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }

    prev.addEventListener('click', () => show(k - 1));
    next.addEventListener('click', () => show(k + 1));
    dots.forEach((d, i) => d.addEventListener('click', () => show(i)));
    if (playBtn) {
      playBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        playing = !playing;
        playBtn.textContent = playing ? 'Pausa' : 'Animar';
        if (playing && last === null) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      });
    }
    root.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') show(k + 1); if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') show(k - 1); });
    if (cv) {
      new IntersectionObserver(es => { visible = es[0].isIntersecting; if (visible && (playing || stepAnim < 1) && last === null) requestAnimationFrame(frame); }).observe(cv);
      let lastW = 0;
      new ResizeObserver(() => {
        const w = cv.parentElement.clientWidth;
        if (Math.abs(w - lastW) > 1) { lastW = w; layout(); draw(); }
      }).observe(cv.parentElement);
      layout();
    }
    show(0);
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-anim=mode]').forEach(modeAnim);
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-anim=chain]').forEach(stepper);
})();

<style>
:root {

}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {

    --accent: #93a8ff; --ok: #62c99c; --ok-bg: #12291f; --flag: #f1a84d; --flag-bg: #2b2112;
    --bad: #f08a90; --bad-bg: #2d1518; --code-bg: #1b2433; color-scheme: dark;

}
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --paper: #0d121b; --sheet: #141b27; --ink: #e3e8f1; --muted: #98a3b7; --rule: #263042;
  --accent: #93a8ff; --ok: #62c99c; --ok-bg: #12291f; --flag: #f1a84d; --flag-bg: #2b2112;

}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
body {

.wrap {
  display: grid;

}
.wrap > * { grid-column: content; min-width: 0; }
.wrap > .wide { grid-column: full; width: min(1040px, 100%); justify-self: center; }

/* Grid de tarjetas */
.grid3 {

/* Tabla de tropiezos */
.tablewrap {

El aprendizaje clave de este proyecto es que <b>el agente nunca hace el álgebra de cabeza: programa a un sistema de álgebra computacional (SymPy) desde la acción y diseña un arnés de pruebas que exige cero exacto</b>.</p>
      <p>Así se invierten los papeles habituales: el físico define la acción, el <i>ansatz</i> métrico, las aproximaciones físicas y qué límites tienen sentido; el agente escribe el código tensorial, ejecuta las reducciones simbólicas, planta errores artificiales para probar el comparador y compila las ecuaciones verificadas directamente a código numérico sin reescribirlas a mano.</p>
